title: Crystal ball
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='26' ry='9' fill='#5a3a8a'/>
  <rect x='30' y='73' width='40' height='10' rx='4' fill='#8a5cc4'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='73' rx='20' ry='6' fill='#a87fdb'/>
  <!-- Base rim highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='26' ry='9' fill='none' stroke='#7a5aaa' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Stand connector -->
  <rect x='44' y='63' width='12' height='12' rx='3' fill='#9b72d0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='8' ry='3' fill='#b899e3'/>
  <!-- Crystal ball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='43' r='28' fill='#a8d8f0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='43' r='28' fill='url(#shine)'/>
  <!-- Inner glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='43' r='20' fill='#d4ecfa' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='43' r='13' fill='#eaf6fd' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Misty swirl inside -->
  <path d='M38 38 Q46 30 54 38 Q62 46 54 50 Q46 54 42 48' fill='none' stroke='#c8e8f8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M58 48 Q64 42 60 36' fill='none' stroke='#c8e8f8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Highlight shine on ball -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='32' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.55' transform='rotate(-25 42 32)'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='29' r='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Bottom reflection -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='15' ry='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.15'/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'>
    <polygon points='68,25 69.5,28.5 73,30 69.5,31.5 68,35 66.5,31.5 63,30 66.5,28.5'/>
    <polygon points='32,52 33,54 35,55 33,56 32,58 31,56 29,55 31,54'/>
    <polygon points='64,55 64.8,57 67,58 64.8,59 64,61 63.2,59 61,58 63.2,57'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Tiny stars around ball -->
  <g fill='#ffe68a' opacity='0.7'>
    <circle cx='78' cy='38' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='35' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='75' cy='50' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='25' cy='48' r='1'/>
  </g>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='shine' cx='0.4' cy='0.3' r='0.7'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7fc4e8' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
</svg>
